scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The Connection Lab
scenes.caption: The Connection Lab lends imaginary field kits only when a learner has permission and has completed training. Tara writes both checks separately. Neel sees permission on a practice card and approves the loan without reading the training field, which is marked no.
scenes.speech: The Connection Lab lends imaginary field kits only when a learner has permission and has completed training. Tara writes both checks separately. Neel sees permission on a practice card and approves the loan without reading the training field, which is marked no.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: What changed?
scenes.caption: The supplied AND rule requires both conditions to be true. One true condition does not compensate for a false one. The team traces complete yes-or-no cases first, then puts a card with missing training information aside for review rather than inventing a value to finish the table.
scenes.speech: The supplied AND rule requires both conditions to be true. One true condition does not compensate for a false one. The team traces complete yes-or-no cases first, then puts a card with missing training information aside for review rather than inventing a value to finish the table.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Follow the evidence
scenes.caption: The teacher introduces a separate pretend badge rule: a drawing or a poem is enough. This OR rule accepts either condition and also accepts both. Tara labels the changed rule clearly. A correct answer under one rule can become incorrect when the connecting word changes.
scenes.speech: The teacher introduces a separate pretend badge rule: a drawing or a poem is enough. This OR rule accepts either condition and also accepts both. Tara labels the changed rule clearly. A correct answer under one rule can become incorrect when the connecting word changes.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Decide and explain
scenes.caption: The kit rule requires permission AND completed training. Both values are known. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.speech: The kit rule requires permission AND completed training. Both values are known. Compare the actions, then explain which evidence supports your decision.
scenes.dialogue: Permission is yes and training is no. Can the kit be lent?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Check the consequence
scenes.caption: No. The training condition is false, so the supplied AND rule is not satisfied even though permission is true.
scenes.speech: No. The training condition is false, so the supplied AND rule is not satisfied even though permission is true.
scenes.dialogue: Distinguish OR from AND under a changed rule.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Investigate in the lab
scenes.caption: Investigate both conditions, then either condition, then unknown inputs. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.speech: Investigate both conditions, then either condition, then unknown inputs. Test your plan, read feedback and try a changed case. Save evidence; explain one limitation.
scenes.dialogue: How can changing AND to OR change the same case’s outcome?
